 The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills ' Dorit Kemsley revealed new insight into her kids, career, and friendships today.
 By Casey Suglia Nov 16, 2026, 11:41 AM ET Dorit Kemsley Reacts to Paul “PK” Kemsley and Ken Todd Hanging Out 1:45 Show Highlight Have the RHOBH Ladies Congratulated Dorit Kemsley on Her Book Coming Out?! 1:17 Show Highlight Jasmine Goode Names the Valley Cast Member with the Biggest Ego 1:15 Show Highlight Can Dorit Kemsley Name Three Cast Members from The Valley?! Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google Key Takeaways
 Dorit Kemsley launched her new low-calorie cocktail brand, Maison D'OR Cocktails, in Beverly Hills and described it as the start of a “golden new chapter” in her life.
 Amid her divorce from PK Kemsley, Dorit shared that she stepped back from social media while navigating major personal changes but says life is now improving and she feels optimistic about the future.
 Dorit credited her children, Jagger and Phoenix, as her main source of strength and expressed gratitude for supportive friendships with women from RHOBH, including Bozoma Saint John, Kyle Richards, and Erika Jayne.
 Dorit Kemsley is sharing a rare update on her life today amid a major career move. The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills mom of two has been so busy raising her children and focusing on her personal life amid her divorce from her ex-husband, Paul "PK" Kemsley , and has been focusing on her latest venture into the beverage industry.
 How to Watch
 The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills  is streaming now on Peacock .
 Stream on Dorit is behind the new low-calorie cocktail brand, Maison D'OR Cocktails, which launched in Beverly Hills on Saturday, Nov. 14. Dorit took to Instagram on Nov. 14, where she posted a video of her posing for photos with her new bottled cocktails. "A golden new chapter is coming," she captioned the video.
 She then took to Instagram on Sunday, Nov. 15, where she opened up about the brand and launch. Dorit's friends came out to support the launch.  "Watching Maison D'OR come to life surrounded by friends, and so much love was a moment I'll always treasure," she wrote in the caption of the post. "To everyone who believed in our vision, helped bring it to life, and joined us to celebrate — thank you. Here's to new beginnings, beautiful memories, and everything still to come. The next chapter is golden."

 Dorit Kemsley opens up about the "big changes" in her life
 Dorit spoke with Us Weekly at the launch party where she shared why she's been so quiet on Instagram . "I was navigating a lot of big life changes in my life, and it was enough just to really put one foot in front of the other — let alone go on social media," she said. "And I'm not exactly going to show that life was great when quite frankly, it wasn't," she said.
 However, things are looking up for Dorit. "But I will say, life is looking a lot better, and I'm very, very excited about this next chapter," she said.
 Dorit Kemsley during Watch What Happens Live With Andy Cohen.
 Photo: Charles Sykes/Bravo RELATED: Dorit Kemsley Makes a Rare Statement About Her Life Today (PHOTO) 
 Dorit Kemsley shares an update on her two kids, Jagger and Phoenix Kemsley
 Dorit has also been putting a lot of her focus and attention into parenting her son, Jagger Kemsley , and her daughter, Phoenix Kemsley , who she told Us Weekly are her "why." "They are absolutely the ones that get me up in the morning, and no matter what's going on in my life, I put on a smile, and I put one foot in front of the other, and that really is for them," she said. "You know, it's them and the strength that they've given me, and I'm so thankful for that every single day."
 Dorit posts a photo of herself with her kids on November 14, 2022 to her Instagram.
 Photo: Dorit Kemsley/Instagram RELATED: Dorit Kemsley Pens Emotional Update Amid Her Divorce From PK: "This Chapter Has Challenged Me" 
 Dorit Kemsley shares where she stands in her RHOBH friendships today
 She also expressed her gratitude for her close friends, whom she met through RHOBH, like Bozoma Saint John . "I will say that the show has introduced me to some incredible women, really incredible, and I'm very grateful to have them in my life," she said. "You know, the world got a chance to see Boz and I meet for the first time , and inside of 20 seconds, there was a love that had been born. Her and I are very close. It's one of the greatest friendships I could ever had hoped for or could ask for. She's a champion, but she's not the only one."
 Bozoma and Dorit during Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen Season 22, Episode 12 on January 21, 2024 in New York City.
 Photo: Charles Sykes/Bravo Although Dorit had her differences with Kyle and Erika throughout RHOBH Season 15 , she told the publication that she is also so thankful forboth of them. "I mean, these are friendships that I've had for over a decade," she said. "So I'm very, very grateful. Even for the dark moments or moments that we are not as close, we tend to come out stronger."
 Learn more about the current status of Kyle and Dorit's friendship , according to Kyle's daughter, Alexia Umansky .
